answer: Prism-gated multi-domain identity: a new identity must present attestations from three independent domains — for example work, a payment history, and a community record — each signed by a different issuer who stakes reputation on its truth, and the registry rejects any set sharing an issuer. A fable in one domain cannot pass the harbor gate, because the other two must independently corroborate it. Forging one puppet means infiltrating three vetting systems; forging thousands means doing that thousands of times over, with each domain able to revoke its attestation and collapse the fake.
